task_title: Floor 2 Quartermaster stock and atomic purchasing

plan_review.notes: Alt A generate-on-purchase rejected because it makes displayed stock non-authoritative and shifts exact identity to click time. Alt B dedicated ECS subsystem rejected because stock is floor-lifecycle state, not per-frame behavior. Alt C optimistic snapshot/rollback rejected because fully precomputed immutable commit state is simpler and cannot expose partial writes. Adopted derived RNG injection and parity tests; first-class epoch stock owner with stale-offer IDs; exported player-owner query; quantity-one exact offers; non-weapon stat-only common/uncommon catalog until generated weapons/grants are equippable; explicit infinite-bag capacity predicate; one shared eligibility/utility projection; deterministic pricing; initial floor-load restock plus monotonic idempotent epoch API; and failure/property/integration coverage.
